name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: 'cutscene_event' domain + 'script' resource. Accurately reflects the body (dereferences the cutscene-event script pointer table). No Ghidra address residue in the name. The sole caller fd2_cutscene_event_trigger confirms the cutscene/walk-animation-event semantics.
purpose: Leaf accessor returning the script byte-stream pointer for a given cutscene/walk-animation event id.
logic_summary: Single-expression accessor: returns data_fd2_chapter_cutscene_event_script_ptr_table_106[event_id], i.e. dereferences the 106-entry pointer table at 0x627D8 (4-byte stride). Assembly: EAX = [event_id*4 + 0x627D8]. No bounds check, no side effects.

params.name: class_id
params.semantics: Cutscene/walk-animation event id, range 0..105 (106 entries). Indexes the script pointer table. NOT a class id -- 'class_id' is leftover from the original misnaming; src already uses the correct name 'event_id'.
params.reason: Live Ghidra parameter is named 'class_id', which is a misnomer confirmed by the plate NOTE and by the sole caller fd2_cutscene_event_trigger (passes a cutscene event_id in range [0,105]). Rename live Ghidra param to 'event_id' in Stage 2 to match src and actual semantics.

returns.semantics: Pointer to the cutscene script byte-stream for the given event_id (an entry of the table at 0x627D8 pointing into the contiguous script block at 0x62980..0x634D1). Caller interprets it as a walk-animation byte-script.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct and concise but described the function generically ('Dereferences pointer table') without recording the event_id range/table size (106) or the not-a-class-id caveat.
notes: Sole caller: fd2_cutscene_event_trigger @ 0x1366A. Global table data_fd2_chapter_cutscene_event_script_ptr_table_106[106] declared in src/include/globals.h and defined in src/table/chtab3.c (@ 0x627D8); '_106' suffix is a real domain dimension (106 entries), not address residue. Ghidra plate already detailed and consistent with the refined understanding (documents table layout, event_id semantics, misnaming caveat, caller) -> left unchanged. Only changes this shard: src/table/table.c comment augmentation + (Stage 2) param rename class_id -> event_id.
